source: Meidensha quarterly results: Meidensha Corporation Reports Earnings for the Three Months Ended June 30, 2026 (07-31-2026)

Meidensha.why: Japanese maker of transformers and power T&D equipment; data-center construction and grid build-out drive transformer demand, which it is meeting with a plant expansion (about 1.5x capacity) and higher Power Infrastructure sales.
Meidensha.evidence: Meidensha Q1 FY2026 results (07-31-2026): 'the transition to SF6 gas-free products progressed against a backdrop of new and expanded data center construction'; Power Infrastructure net sales +39.9% to JPY 27,574 million on U.S. demand growth and a large project in India.

players.product: Power transformers and substation / transmission-and-distribution equipment, including SF6 gas-free products; Numazu transformer plant expansion to about 1.5x capacity

quarterly_data.signal: Three months ended June 30, 2026: net sales JPY 73,412 million (+25.7% YoY), operating income JPY 4,664 million (prior year JPY 348 million), net income attributable to owners of the parent JPY 5,059 million (+986.6%); orders JPY 104,650 million (112.4% YoY); overseas ratio of sales 34.2% (31.0%)
quarterly_data.figure: net sales JPY 73,412 million (+25.7%); orders JPY 104,650 million
quarterly_data.quarter: Meidensha quarterly results: Meidensha Corporation Reports Earnings for the Three Months Ended June 30, 2026 (07-31-2026)

quarterly_data.signal: Power Infrastructure segment: in the Power T&D business, mainly overseas, sales and income increased on demand growth in the U.S. and progress on a large-scale project in India; in the Power & Energy business, mainly in Japan, sales and income increased on steady progress of projects for electric power companies. Segment net sales rose 39.9% to JPY 27,574 million and operating income improved by JPY 2,283 million to JPY 3,941 million; segment orders JPY 27,854 million (FY2025 Q1: 23,039 million) against a full-year orders forecast of JPY 132,800 million
quarterly_data.figure: Power Infrastructure net sales JPY 27,574 million (+39.9%); orders JPY 27,854 million
quarterly_data.quarter: Meidensha quarterly results: Meidensha Corporation Reports Earnings for the Three Months Ended June 30, 2026 (07-31-2026)

quarterly_data.signal: Management on the market: investment in expanding and renewing power transmission and distribution facilities, disaster resilience and decarbonization remained firm on increasing electricity demand in Japan and overseas and the power infrastructure renewal cycle; the transition to SF6 gas-free products progressed against a backdrop of new and expanded data center construction and tighter environmental regulations; the outlook remains uncertain due to U.S. trade policy, Middle East geopolitical risk and rising energy and raw material prices. The company continues to improve production efficiency and strengthen supply chain resilience
quarterly_data.quarter: Meidensha quarterly results: Meidensha Corporation Reports Earnings for the Three Months Ended June 30, 2026 (07-31-2026)

quarterly_data.signal: Forecasts raised for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027: full-year net sales JPY 365,000 million (previous JPY 355,000 million), operating income JPY 33,000 million (29,000 million), net income attributable to owners of the parent JPY 25,000 million (22,000 million); first half net sales JPY 155,000 million (148,000 million) and operating income JPY 8,000 million (4,000 million); full-year orders forecast JPY 395,000 million. Management cites robust demand in the Power Infrastructure business, continued progress on percentage-of-completion projects and better Social Infrastructure Systems profitability, despite concerns over delayed new vehicle model launches in the EV business
quarterly_data.figure: FY net sales JPY 365,000 million; operating income JPY 33,000 million
quarterly_data.quarter: Meidensha quarterly results: Meidensha Corporation Reports Earnings for the Three Months Ended June 30, 2026 (07-31-2026)

quarterly_data.signal: Capex JPY 7,007 million in Q1 (FY2025 Q1: 3,408 million) against a full-year forecast of JPY 32,000 million (FY2025: 18,082 million); Power Infrastructure capex JPY 2,611 million in Q1 with a full-year forecast of JPY 15,200 million (FY2025: 5,469 million)
quarterly_data.figure: FY capex forecast JPY 32,000 million; Power Infrastructure JPY 15,200 million
quarterly_data.quarter: Meidensha quarterly results: Meidensha Corporation Reports Earnings for the Three Months Ended June 30, 2026 (07-31-2026)

quarterly_data.signal: Other segments: Public, Industrial & Commercial Sector net sales +33.5% to JPY 20,124 million (large-scale and percentage-of-completion projects); Mobility & Electrical Components net sales +13.3% to JPY 17,423 million, with EV sales and income down on a shift in timing of certain vehicle models while Electronics Products orders increased on recovery in semiconductor-related markets; Field Service Engineering net sales +7.0% to JPY 9,267 million
quarterly_data.figure: Public sector JPY 20,124 million; Mobility JPY 17,423 million
